# Sprint CLI reference

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

## Install

```sh
npm install --global @hyungjuk/sprint
sprint --version
```

CLI installation does not configure a Sprint server or authentication. Start with [authentication](reference/topic/authentication.md), [automation](reference/topic/automation.md) and the [AI guide](agents.md).

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint — manage work, projects, issues and sprints.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint COMMAND [ARGS] [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Use command groups to discover operations. Help is available offline without Sprint authentication.

COMMAND GROUPS
  accounts            Browse subcommands.
  audit               Browse subcommands.
  auth                Scoped automation-token management.
  backlogs            Browse subcommands.
  calendar            Calendar dates and holidays.
  cycles              Project-scoped sprint lifecycle and policies.
  documents           Project and sprint documents.
  events              Browse subcommands.
  four-dx             Goals, leads, commitments, observations, reports and scoreboards.
  github              Repository connections, mappings, jobs and synchronization.
  help                Browse command help or search commands, flags and descriptions.
  inbox               Browse subcommands.
  invitations         Browse subcommands.
  issues              Issues, comments, relations, history and execution links.
  labels              Browse subcommands.
  login               Verifies token identity without saving a session; password login creates a session only in standalone local mode
  logout              Revokes server session and removes local session
  mcp                 Connect an AI agent through a stdio MCP server.
  members             Browse subcommands.
  metadata            Read authoritative currentMemberId, statuses, priorities and permitted member/team DTOs
  milestones          Browse subcommands.
  my                  Browse subcommands.
  organization        Members, teams, roles, memberships and lifecycle.
  projects            Projects, metadata, updates and restoration.
  retrospectives      Browse subcommands.
  scrums              Browse subcommands.
  search              Search filters current access before counts and pagination. Views enforce personal ownership or linked native team membership. Subscription
  settings            Browse subcommands.
  signups             Browse subcommands.
  sprints             Sprint records and iteration.
  subgoals            Browse subcommands.
  subscriptions       Browse subcommands.
  teams               Browse subcommands.
  templates           Team issue templates.
  topic               Authentication, output, revisions and AI usage guides.
  update              Check the latest stable CLI version and confirm installation with y/n.
  version             Print the installed CLI version; aliases: --version, -v.
  views               Browse subcommands.
  whoami              Read identity
  work-teams          Work teams, prefixes and archives.
  workflows           Team workflow settings.

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues --help
  sprint issues get --help
  sprint help -- subscription
  sprint --schema issues

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

SEE ALSO
  sprint topic automation
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/tree/main/cli
```
